mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and increased discount rates, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods following a sustained increase in HOUST over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the historical average by more than 1%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds the historical average by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increasing nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of periods following a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS over three months.
